pyramiding_rule: Zero pyramiding permitted within a 60-second window; scaling into positions requires confirmed 3-bar structural continuation and a minimum 1.50 profit buffer on prior tranches.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Mandatory Order Flow Imbalance (OFI) confirmation and spread check (< 30 pts) prior to execution, completely blocking entries during high-frequency volatility clusters.
profit_harvest_threshold: Aggressively trigger trailing stop activation and partial harvesting at +$10.00 to ensure profit retention and prevent evaporation.
